messages:
sam: Heads-up — canaries on rack-3 are OOMing ~30–45m into the long-chat benchmark. RSS climbs steadily until the kernel kills the process. Anyone seen this pattern recently?

deploy-bot: Canary r10 deployed to rack-3 (model-x, us-west) :rocket:

lee: saw the alert. do you have the pmap/smaps and the runtime jemalloc stats? quick checks first.

sam: putting a couple links and excerpts here: https://logs.internal/redwood/canary/r10 and https://perf.internal/trace/1855302

snip:
```
# ps aux | grep model-runtime
redwood 12345  45.3 10.2 1623456 1048576 ? Sl  12:01  22:11 /srv/runtime/bin/model-runtime --serve
# pmap 12345 | tail -n 2
total           1648576K
```

The RSS keeps climbing by ~30–40MB / min under the long-chat workload.

anjali: this smells like the prefix/persistent cache growth we saw in the streaming refactor — recall PR #1423 changed eviction behaviour. did that landing also change the default TTL?

ben: +1 to checking jemalloc stats and smaps. can you run these on the canary pid?

```
sudo cat /proc/12345/smaps | egrep "Private|Rss" | awk '{sum+=$2}END{print sum}'
curl -s localhost:9090/debug/allocs | head -n 200
jeprof --text /usr/lib/libjemalloc.so.2 jeprof.out
```

also `mallinfo()` snapshot and `jemalloc stats` output would help.

jordan: fwiw i grepped recent commits — there's one that toggled prefix-cache retention (commit 1f2a3b4) and added a `cache::retain_forever` flag behind a feature. could be defaulting on in canary config.

sam: ran `cat /proc/12345/smaps` and posted output to the logs link above. result: private anonymous segments increasing, not just file-backed mmaps. restarted canary and memory drops immediately. so not pure kernel leak.

mica: i can spin an instrumented canary with MALLOC_CONF="stats_print:true,lg_dirty_mult:0" and `RT_DEBUG_PREFIX_CACHE=1` for 1 hour. that should print jemalloc stats on exit and add prefix-cache counters to /debug/metrics. want me to do that?

sam: please do — tag me when it's up. also can we add a temporary evict TTL override in the config to confirm?

anjali: i can push a quick config override (evict_ttl=60s) to the canary group and watch. if memory stops growing that's a smoking gun. i'll do it now and report in 20m.

ben: if it's still growing after TTL=60s, run a bisect: revert 1f2a3b4 locally and run 10m reproduction. if growth disappears, we know where to start.

lee: also capture `je_malloc_stats_print(NULL, NULL, NULL);` output (jemalloc) at periodic intervals — put it into /tmp/je_stats_<pid>.txt every 5m so we can diff.

sam: done — added the periodic dump, and anjali pushed TTL override. current canary: https://logs.internal/redwood/canary/r10/ttl60. i'll post results.

20m later...

anjali: update — after TTL override memory growth flatlined; RSS stabilized around 420MB for the long-chat worker. no OOMs in the last 18m. looks like eviction was not firing in r10 config.

jordan: excellent. can you still capture the jemalloc periodic dumps and attach? I want to check for retained extents vs active pages.

sam: attaching `/tmp/je_stats_12345.txt` snippets in the logs link. key lines:
```
allocated: 320MB
active: 640MB
mapped: 1024MB
retained: 256MB
```

ben: retained=256MB suggests some cached arenas/extents not being returned. combined with prefix-cache not evicting, that explains the growth. plan: 1) revert the feature flag default in next patch, 2) add a short TTL default and make it configurable, 3) add a canary test that runs long-chat for 1h on each merge.

anjali: filed an issue and PR draft to revert default and add TTL config: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/issue/2368 and PR #1467 (draft).

mica: instrumented canary finished and uploaded full jemalloc dump. i also left a lightweight `heapshot` hook so we can compare before/after. link: https://artifacts.internal/heapshots/1855302_r10_zip

lee: reassigning to eng-runtime for follow-up rollout. action items:
- anjali: revert default in PR and add config (assigned)
- ben: write a regression test for long-chat memory profile (assigned)
- mica: keep the instrumented canary running for another 2h to be safe (assigned)
- sam: monitor rack-3 and post OOM if seen (assigned)

sam: sgtm. thanks all. i'll leave the canary under TTL=60s for another 2h and report back. :thumbsup:

ben: quick Q — should we add an alert for retained>active ratio > 0.4? would have flagged this earlier.

lee: +1 to that alert, put it in monitoring playbook and add runbook steps for `je_stats` collection.

sam: noted. will create alert PR after we stabilise.

mica: FYI i found a small leak in the prefix-index when streaming ends without ack; i'll open a tiny fix PR that makes eviction immediate on stream termination (non-breaking).

anjali: nice. link when ready and we'll roll it through canary.

sam: closing loop — memory stable for 2.5h now, no further OOMs. keeping canary pinned to TTL=60s until PR merges. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
